title: Introduce session waiter, per-session lock, and active-event interruption boundaries
description: AstrBot has explicit session waiters, per-session locks, and active event interruption registries for multi-turn plugin commands and reset/stop behavior. Rust should isolate these controls before plugin SDK, agent runner, and pipeline scheduling grow more stateful.

files.change: Model pending multi-turn waits and history capture outside plugin handlers.
Serialize per-session command/event handling through a reusable typed lock manager.
Support reset/stop requests without coupling event state to pipeline stages.

criteria: Session waiting can be tested without real platforms.
Per-session locks do not live inside plugin SDK or scheduler internals.
Agent stop/event stop requests have a typed registry boundary.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-core && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
